chunks: Abān narrated from al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik or Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man: does he inherit his wife's house and her land, anything from the soil, or is he in that regard like the woman, so that he does not inherit anything from that? He said: He inherits from her, and she inherits from him, from everything that he leaves and that she leaves.

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ: in the same legal position as the woman
key_terms.مِنَ التُّرْبَةِ: from the soil itself, meaning the land property
key_terms.مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ: from everything; all categories of the estate
key_terms.يَرِثُ: inherits; receives a share of the estate

ai.seo_question: Does a husband inherit land and a house from his wife in Shia inheritance law?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling about spousal inheritance, specifically whether a husband inherits from his wife's house and land. The Imam عليه السلام states that each spouse inherits from the other from all that either leaves behind.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5753 - Aban narrated from Al-Faḍl ibn Abd Al-Malik or Ibn Abi Yaʿfur from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"I asked Imam (as) about a man - does he inherit his wife's house and land from the soil, or is he like the woman who does not inherit anything from that?"
Imam (as) replied: "He inherits from her, and she inherits from him, from everything either of them leaves behind."
